ACTIVE 2026-10-09 (proposal F1), re-tuned: the pool shares the archetype's product unit (a share per tonne and a share per GJ behave differently), the nearest pool needs 3 archetypes (same equipment) or 5 (family, then all), and the range is the pool's interquartile span rather than its extremes. The capex it scales may itself be a fill; the result inherits that grade. A fourth pool level (2026-10-09) takes archetypes of any product unit, since the ratio is per year of the same unit on both sides; it is reached only where the m3 and m archetypes have no pool of their own. rationale: ACTIVE (re-enabled; design.md). The capex it scales may itself be a fill; the result inherits that grade. A fourth pool level (2026-10-09) takes archetypes of any product unit, since the ratio is per year of the same unit on both sides; it is reached only where the m3 and m archetypes have no pool of their own.
